CVE-2026-97689 is fixed in urllib3 2.8.0, but pip 26.2.1 still identifies its vendored copy as urllib3 2.7.0 and upstream pip has not released a wheel that vendors the corrected release. For Debian variants, DHI python3-pip 26.2.1-2 backports the correction, but verification is still needed that each published image consumes the corrected package and does not also contain an independent application-installed copy. The current image is reported with pkg:pypi/urllib3@2.7.0; assessment is in progress to distinguish pip's vendored copy from any application-installed copy, verify the published package and rebuild state for each variant, and evaluate reachability before assigning a final VEX status. Advisory: https://github.com/urllib3/urllib3/security/advisories/GHSA-vxq7-64xx-v4gw
